Display

TOOLBAR
Select — drag a gate to move it; select a plot (click its top bar or empty space on it) to get blue cofactor markers on its ASINH axes
Polygon — click points, click the first point (or double-click) to close
Rect — drag a rectangle
Quadrant — click to place a crosshair (Q1–Q4 clockwise from upper right); drag it with Select or Edit
Edit — drag gate vertices
Comp — drag a plot's top or right edge to tune spillover
Delete — click a gate to remove it
Autocomp — outline a population that should sit flat; spillover is fitted for you
Ctrl/⌘+Z undo · Shift+Z or Y redo
PLOTS
Click a plot's top bar, or any empty space on it (blank canvas with Select, Edit or Delete; the margins; gaps beside the axis menus) — select (highlight) it; the cofactor markers need this
Click empty canvas — deselect all
Shift+Click — range-select plots
Ctrl/⌘+Click — toggle selection
Del/⌫ — remove selected plot(s)
Esc — cancel gate / deselect all
S Select · G Polygon · R Rect · Q Quadrant · E Edit · C Comp · A Autocomp · D 1D range · Delete Delete mode (when no plot is selected; otherwise it removes the selected plots)
Drag ⠿ — reorder plots; drop on a tab to move it
Drag the strip beside a side panel — change its width · Click it — hide / show the panel
Right-click canvas — axis range / cofactor
Right-click header — switch source file
Slider — density bins per axis (32–1024; high values suit the expanded view)
ARCSINH COFACTOR
1. Click the plot's top bar (the row with the population menu and bins slider), or any empty space on the plot; the plot gets a blue outline
2. With Select active, a blue marker appears on each ASINH axis: drag it along the axis to set that channel's cofactor live (files open at 300)
Esc while dragging cancels; the change is undoable and appears in History
Right-click the plot to type an exact value
No marker? The plot is not selected, another tool is active, or that axis is not ASINH
WORKSPACES AND POOL
Opened files wait in the Pool; a workspace is one template with its own files, plots and undo
↑ Import Template — matches the Pool's files and opens a new workspace
Open / Starter (Pool, on ticked files) — blank workspace / starter plots per tube
Click a workspace tab — switch · Dbl-click — rename · ✕ — close (removes its files and gates)
TABS
Right-click or Dbl-click tab — rename
✕ — close tab · + Tab — add a tab
Plot size slider (right end of the tab strip) — size of every plot on this tab; saved with templates and shared files
POPULATION TREE
+ — also draw this population as exact events (dots)
× — delete gate and children
Right-click row — rename / color, copy, cut, paste, delete
Shift+Click row — rename / color
Right-click file row — paste a gate at the top level
Drag row onto another — re-parent
Drag ⠿ above/below a sibling — reorder; the lower one wins shared cells
Click name — jump to the gate's plot
HISTORY AND SAVING
🕘 History — every change with its time (no user names); undo and redo are logged too
💾 Save — shared files only: writes a new copy with your gates, plots, compensation and History; the original is not changed
↺ Reset — back to the author's gates and compensation (undoable)
MULTI-SELECT (2+ plots)
Axis / pop / bin / scale (LOG/LIN/ASINH) changes apply to all selected.
